nodes.text:
About #Human_Metapneumovirus
Human metapneumovirus (#HMPV) is a respiratory virus identified in 2001 that commonly affects the respiratory tract, particularly in children, older adults, and those with weakened immune systems.
#outbreak #reports https://t.co/Xeno6SOexo

nodes.author: COVID19Update
nodes.text: Similar to the common #cold or #flu, HMPV infections present with symptoms like cough, congestion, runny nose, sore throat, fever, and fatigue.

nodes.author: COVID19Update
nodes.text: In some cases, particularly in vulnerable populations, HMPV infections can lead to more severe respiratory conditions such as bronchiolitis or pneumonia, requiring medical intervention.

nodes.author: COVID19Update
nodes.text: However, for most healthy individuals, HMPV infections typically resolve on their own with supportive care.
